name: ooeyama-direction-cipher
reviewNotes: Original six records reviewed as glyphs. The Japanese row/vowel cipher decodes to right, left, left, up, right, down, right; corroborated by https://tvgamedb.com/snec/shinmomoden/kouryaku-3/.
Editorial localization replaces kana decomposition with Mandarin same-tone homophones: 又=右, 佐=左, 尚=上, 夏=下. The sunrise example 冬=東 supplies the decoding rule without printing the solution.
Only dialogue is localized; the movement sequence, event scripts, three choice outcomes, and text controls are unchanged. Natural puzzle interaction and native rendering remain unverified.
